summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on firmware and embedded systems experience spanning STM32 bare-metal C, FreeRTOS, and embedded Linux platforms (NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi). Builds, tests, and debugs firmware -- GPIO/ADC/UART/I2C/SPI drivers, oscilloscope/logic-analyzer hardware debugging, and systemd automation -- plus AI-related exposure (YOLO, ONNX) most firmware candidates lack.

Linux & Automation: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth for hands-free HID control.
Implemented a tap-detection algorithm; resolved sensor jitter via hardware debugging, software calibration, and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed custom PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) -- MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures through hardware/firmware debugging; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service with auto-restart and static IP networking; configured XRDP for headless remote administration.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop -- Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon -- National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
